title: Modular add-ons gating playbook: retention tiers, compliance bundle, premium SLA experiments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket captures the design and execution plan for a set of pricing and packaging experiments that modularize high‑value enterprise add-ons: extended observability retention, a compliance bundle (audit logs + dedicated policy controls), and a premium SLA offering. Goal: validate willingness-to-pay, clarify gate logic, and surface engineering effort for Dedicated/Private customers. Deliverables: 1) experiment matrix (variants + pricing suggestions), 2) gating/playbook for console and API features behind flags, 3) contract language and security questionnaire answers draft, 4) telemetry to measure conversion, churn risk, and NRR impact.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment matrix with at least 6 pricing+feature variants reviewed by GTM and Legal
Console gating prototypes for retention toggle and compliance opt-in behind feature flags
Draft contract addenda and completed security questionnaire (v1) for enterprise legal review
Instrumentation: conversion funnel events + cohort retention metrics defined and implemented by ENG for two pilot accounts
Go/no-go decision framework and A/B criteria documented and approved
comments: 2026-01-28 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff — scoped three add-ons to pilot: observability retention tiers (30/90/365 days), compliance bundle (audit logs + export controls), premium SLA (99.95% + white-glove onboarding). Asked Eng for rough effort estimates and Design for console UX sketches.

2026-02-03 - Marco Liu (Eng lead): Provided initial effort breakdown: retention storage + query cost ~ 2 sprint-quarters largely infra; feature flagging + console components ~ 4-6 weeks; SLA operational runbooks depends on Dedicated capacity changes.

2026-02-10 - Diego Ramos: Ran first pricing brainstorm with Sales and CS. Sales prefers per-seat for SLA + per-GB/month for retention; Finance suggests blended per-tenant fee for large committed accounts. Need experiments to validate elasticity.

2026-02-18 - Design review (DES-114): Console mockups uploaded. Feedback: make retention UX reversible, show incremental cost estimate in console when toggling retention, add clear legal link for compliance opt-in.

2026-02-25 - Legal (review): Requested draft contract language for data retention changes and indemnity for compliance pack. Also flagged enterprise security questionnaire items requiring input from Security (KMS/HSM, audit log retention, SOC/ISO certifications).
2026-03-01 - ENG-3021: Instrumentation task accepted — events defined for 'addon_offer_seen','addon_opt_in','addon_purchase' and retention toggles; backlog ticket created for telemetry pipeline work.

2026-03-05 - Pilot selection: Identified two pilot customers (beta) with Dedicated deployments willing to trial retention tiers and compliance pack; Sales and CSM owners assigned. Legal agreed to share a custom addendum template.

2026-03-09 - Diego Ramos: Draft security questionnaire answers attached and marked for Security team review. Noted three open Qs around on-prem KMS support, audit log export retention policies, and incident notification windows.

2026-03-12 - PM review: Consolidated experiment matrix and recommended two concurrent A/B experiments: 1) Retention pricing elasticity (per-GB vs per-tenant) with 30 vs 365 day cap; 2) Compliance bundle as a single add-on vs modular a la carte. Preparing go/no-go for 2026-03-20 steering.
decision_log: 2026-02-03: Chose three retention buckets for experiments (30, 90, 365 days) to balance cost and enterprise needs
2026-02-10: Pricing signals — Sales prefers per-seat for SLA; Finance prefers per-tenant for retention. Decision: run experiments with both pricing models to observe conversion.
2026-02-25: Compliance pack will initially include audit logs + admin export controls; RBAC fine-grained controls scoped to next phase. Legal approved addendum template for pilots.
2026-03-05: Pilot customers selected; LA team to coordinate dedicated capacity and opt-in timeline.

Merge console gating PR (rw-console PR#1452) once design accessibility feedback addressed
